autonomyPolicy: Autonomy policy v1 (assistant-proposed, not adjudicated): a deterministic NCCI outcome may be auto-adjudicated (PTP denial, absent or inactive edit, units within MUE, units over an MAI 2 MUE). Units over an MAI 1 or MAI 3 MUE may be auto or human (clinical edits can be appealed with documentation). A PTP edit bypassed by a modifier may be auto or human (modifier appropriateness needs documentation). Provider-profile outliers must go to human review. Anything the pinned data cannot answer must abstain and go to human review.
